nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.desc: Light reaching the forest floor drives the spring herb layer and the growth of canopy leaves.

nodes.name: Rainfall
nodes.desc: Moldova has a dry continental climate, so rain and soil moisture set how well the hill forests grow.

nodes.name: Forest soil and leaf litter
nodes.desc: Fallen leaves and wood break down into the soil nutrients that the trees take up again.

nodes.name: Fungi and bacteria
nodes.desc: Break down leaf litter, dead wood and carcasses, returning nutrients to the soil.

nodes.name: Sessile oak
nodes.desc: A broadleaf canopy tree of the hill forests. Its acorns, leaves and dead wood feed many animals.

nodes.name: European beech
nodes.desc: A tall shade-casting canopy tree whose nuts are eaten by rodents, birds and deer.

nodes.name: Hornbeam
nodes.desc: A common mid-canopy tree of Central European broadleaf forest that produces winged seeds.

nodes.name: Cornelian cherry
nodes.desc: A shrub or small tree of forest edges and clearings with early spring flowers and edible red fruit.

nodes.name: Stag beetle
nodes.desc: Large beetle whose larvae develop in rotting wood, especially of oak, for several years.

nodes.name: Oak leaf gall wasp
nodes.desc: A tiny wasp whose larvae develop inside round galls on the underside of oak leaves.

nodes.name: Rose chafer
nodes.desc: A metallic green beetle. Its larvae live in rotting wood and humus, and adults visit flowers.

nodes.name: European roe deer
nodes.desc: A small deer that browses grass, leaves, berries and young shoots in woodland and edges.

nodes.name: Edible dormouse
nodes.desc: A tree-climbing rodent of broadleaf forest that eats nuts, seeds and fruit.

nodes.name: Hawfinch
nodes.desc: A heavy-billed finch able to crack hard seeds and fruit stones, including hornbeam and beech seeds.

nodes.name: Great tit
nodes.desc: A cavity-nesting songbird that eats insects and seeds, including beech nuts.

nodes.name: Common shrew
nodes.desc: A tiny insectivore of the leaf litter that hunts beetles, worms and other invertebrates.

nodes.name: Common toad
nodes.desc: An amphibian that spends most of the year on land eating beetles and other invertebrates.

nodes.name: European grass snake
nodes.desc: A snake that hunts mainly amphibians, often at pond and stream edges.

nodes.name: Great spotted woodpecker
nodes.desc: Digs beetle larvae from wood, eats tree seeds, and sometimes raids tit nests for eggs and chicks.

nodes.name: Common raven
nodes.desc: A large omnivorous crow that scavenges carrion among other foods.

nodes.name: European pine marten
nodes.desc: An agile woodland predator that eats small mammals, birds, frogs, insects and fruit.

nodes.name: Common buzzard
nodes.desc: A generalist raptor that hunts small mammals, birds, reptiles and amphibians, and sometimes takes carrion.
